name: Run script → whisper result
description: Blueprint: a shell node runs a task (GPU or CPU), then a fire-and-forget whisper node delivers the result to an agent. Customize before running — the Run dialog prompts for `command` (the script to run) and `agent` (who to whisper). The run node's timeout is a 12h ceiling; for longer jobs, clone this blueprint and raise it. NOTE the notify message states exit/ok rather than declaring success: core:exec treats a non-zero exit as a RESULT (ok:false), not a node failure, so `run` COMPLETES even when the command died and this edge fires either way. That is unlike the adversarial-design blueprints, whose notify hangs off a node that genuinely fails — their success marker is earned, this one's would not be.
